capture_note: Eight gallery runs at b7f894b: English and Russian at 540x960 and 720x1280, each captured once per skin. The 720x1280 runs use an exact-size SubViewport because a real Windows window is clamped to the 1920x1020 work area on this host.
method: Every frame of both skins was captured at this commit and assembled into eight labelled contact sheets, then the dark set was compared pixel by pixel against the accepted 62c153b capture. Identical frames show the repaint refactor changed nothing outside live values; the changed frames differ only in figures, ages and the portfolio polyline, read from cropped pairs at original size. The ledger, the milestone card, settings and the intro were inspected in both skins, because those are the surfaces this build repairs. The 4784eed set was additionally compared against 2ff705d: the intro, credits and all five ledger sections are byte-identical across that change, which is the measurement that says the credits repaint and the token plumbing left the shipped dark skin as it was.

issues_found.detail: Milestone card, dynasty journal and hall printed raw ranks such as #6233850000.
issues_found.resolution: GameManager.format_rank shared by Main, MilestoneCard and DynastyPanel.

issues_found.detail: The milestone card collapsed to about 180px and wrapped the heading over five lines.
issues_found.resolution: Responsive minimum width at 72% of the viewport clamped to 320-520px.

issues_found.detail: The dynasty backdrop at alpha 0.985 let the life screen bleed through at 720x1280.
issues_found.resolution: Backdrop is now opaque and follows the active skin.
Label is now Threads with the value "%d completed" / "завершено %d".

issues_found.detail: Hall of fame printed "61 лет" in Russian.
issues_found.resolution: GameManager.format_age declines год/года/лет and the English year/years plural.

issues_found.detail: On the paper skin the dynasty ledger and the milestone card stayed ink-dark while every other surface turned light.
issues_found.resolution: Both now listen for theme_changed and repaint their own backdrop and rows.

issues_found.detail: The appearance row in settings printed its two items in Russian inside the English build.
issues_found.resolution: Items are filled through the display translation, and the settings suite asserts the language actually shown.

issues_found.detail: Ledger rows and the ambition explanation used one hardcoded light grey and were close to unreadable on the paper skin.
issues_found.resolution: Both resolve through Palette.muted() at paint time.

issues_found.detail: The skin applier cleared every button font override, which widened the bottom bar past 540 and 360 viewports and printed the raw choice text over the choice card.
issues_found.resolution: Only stylebox overrides are cleared now; font sizes stay with the screen that chose them.

issues_found.detail: The numeral gutter narrowed the text area but the card still measured its height against the old width, cutting the last detail line.
issues_found.resolution: Height is measured against the card margins actually in force.

issues_found.detail: The documented roman numerals never appeared because no card was ever given its index.
issues_found.resolution: Choice cards receive their index at construction; visible in the life frames of both skins.

issues_found.detail: The quote graph showed no unit, scale or axis until something resized it.
issues_found.resolution: Labels are built when the control enters the tree.

issues_found.detail: The two icons added with the appearance system were drawn at 1.5px while every other interface glyph uses 1.75px.
issues_found.resolution: Both reweighted; the audit now checks every icon rather than a fixed count.

issues_found.detail: The intro cover scaled to fill and painted past its own bounds over the caption below it, which read as a scrim in the dark skin and as dark text on a dark photograph in the paper skin.
issues_found.resolution: The cover control now clips its drawing to its own rect.

issues_found.detail: Labels painted while their screen was built kept the previous skin after a switch: the intro brand, the ambition hint and description, the outcome line, ledger rows and backdrop, currency and milestone surfaces.
issues_found.resolution: Text colour is named by token — Palette.paint() records the token on the control and Palette.repaint() re-applies every marked colour when the skin changes; 28 call sites moved to the token path.

issues_found.detail: The outcome tones, the delta chips and the finale carried hardcoded hex copies of the dark tokens instead of the tokens, so they could not follow the paper skin at all.
issues_found.resolution: outcome_tone() and DeltaChips.chip() now name tokens; the finale keeps a deliberately staged sheet whose values are named STAGE_* and asserted identical in both skins rather than excused from the scan.

issues_found.detail: The credits overlay painted its backdrop once at build time and never listened for a skin change. The intro toggle is reachable by keyboard behind that overlay, so switching skins with credits open left near-black body text on the previous dark sheet — a readability defect, not a cosmetic one.
issues_found.resolution: FortuneCredits now re-applies its own backdrop on theme_changed, and the theme case drives exactly that path: open credits, switch skins, require the backdrop and the body colour to follow.

press_frames: docs/press/v2.1.0 (8 frames, manifest and captions record per-file hashes and which frames are staged).
packaging_note: Re-rendered at 2ff705d, the commit that makes the skin switch repaint every colour it owns. It replaces the capture set taken at 62c153b, which showed the stale-ink labels this build fixes.
scope: Presentation review only: clipping, ghosting, formatting, locale fit and skin coverage in captured frames. It does not establish human play, listening or balance acceptance, which remain with the owner.
frame_identity: The intro frame is byte-identical to the previously reviewed capture in all four runs, so the press set in docs/press/v2.1.0 still shows the shipped screen. Frames that print live figures (loading, birth, perk, life, outcome, market, currencies, business, dynasty sections, milestone, settings) differ from the earlier capture only in those values and in tween phase; no layout difference was observed.

dark_skin_comparison.method: The same dark-skin frames were compared pixel by pixel against the baseline capture. Identical frames prove the change touched no presentation surface outside live values; every remaining difference sits in a band holding figures, ages or the portfolio polyline.
